item1.title: Late-night Emotional Flow Perception System Design
item1.desc:
This project designs and implements an emotion-aware interactive system based on physiological signals. The system continuously collects galvanic skin response (GSR) data to monitor users’ real-time emotional arousal levels. A time-based hierarchical response mechanism is introduced to distinguish between short-term fluctuations and sustained emotional states.
In the feedback layer, the system combines both visual and auditory modalities, using light signals and voice prompts to represent emotional changes in a more intuitive way. A user-confirmation mechanism is also incorporated, allowing the system to return to its baseline state after the user actively confirms recovery. This creates a complete closed-loop interaction process.
Overall, this design explores the potential of using physiological data in emotion-regulating interactive systems.
